mechanism_narrative: The INSR-IL6ST exposit_rigid novokine forces proximity between the insulin receptor RTK and gp130 cytokine receptor, creating a hybrid signaling node where INSR's tyrosine kinase transphosphorylates IL6ST's intracellular tyrosines (creating STAT3/5 docking sites) while JAK2 associated with IL6ST phosphorylates IRS1/2 (creating a JAK-to-IRS-to-PI3K axis absent in normal insulin signaling). PLC-gamma is sterically excluded by the rigid scaffold geometry. The biased output combines JAK-STAT3/5 transcriptional programs with enhanced IRS-PI3K-AKT and SHC-MAPK signaling, upregulating muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) via SRF/MRTF and downregulating aged inflammatory IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32) via STAT3-mediated SOCS3 feedback and AKT-mediated FOXO inhibition.
